source.title: Requiem, K. 626 — Dies irae
source.edition: Breitkopf & Härtel, 1877, edited by Johannes Brahms; Süssmayr completion
source.encoder: Martin Norbäck; 2014 update by Francisco Vila

method: Public-domain LilyPond/MIDI → voice-aware performed event table; tuning estimated with librosa; Sync Toolbox 1.4.2 memory-restricted multiscale DTW at 50 frames/s, chroma + DLNCO. First/last attacks anchored by score-pitch energy rises in documented inspection windows; section anchors refined by DTW and checked against existing passage labels. Note-offs are warped notation, not measured key releases; final written holds extend to an estimated decay threshold. No aural review. See tools/align/REPORT.md. Additional internal score attacks are pinned by documented score-pitch energy windows; these are not independent listening annotations.
repeats: All 68 written bars once. Choir ends in bar65; the encoded orchestra continues through68, including the last lower string quarter-note at q269. No repeats or synthetic bass/continuo parts.
